scope: Independent source review of the canonical priced Full128 window compiler; no project test, plan build, scorer, or GPU workload was executed by Web.

findings.finding: Repository paths originally pointed at the controller checkout after harness staging.
findings.evidence: All in-repository runner arguments now use attempt-relative ../ paths; external native source, dataset, and weight roots remain explicit host paths.

findings.finding: A 28800-second driver deadline left the 1800-second collection reserve available to scheduler overhead.
findings.evidence: The driver total wall limit is 27000 seconds while the reporting window remains 28800 seconds and GPU task reservations remain 26624 seconds.

findings.finding: The environment input was neither canonical nor closed over an exact dependency inventory.
findings.evidence: The compiler requires inputs/native-runtime/environment.json, the current interpreter and GPU UUID, exact manifest keys, required package identities, and a verified single dependency inventory reference.

findings.finding: Initial checks did not directly bind the sixteen-plan count and no-retry limits.
findings.evidence: A validation helper now rejects incomplete, reordered, retried, or fallback-bearing plan sets and has an authored focused check.
